author: Debug01-dEoW aka Deep
description: EcoDot 1.27v — A fast 120Hz Android music & video player signed with EcoDot's official release certificate, featuring crystal-clear Liquid Glass optics, Spotify-inspired playlists, interactive circular profile photo cropping, full scrollable 3-dots track actions, Apple Music / Vinyl / Spotify Now Playing styles, seamless 1080p video playback, AutoMix DJ crossfade, and YouTube Music streaming — crafted by Debug01-dEoW aka Deep.

News & Highlights: **Official Release Key Signing**: EcoDot `1.27v` is now signed with a dedicated RSA-2048 release certificate (`CN=Debug01-dEoW, OU=EcoDot, O=Deep Patel, C=IN`) to establish Google Play Protect trust across installs. *(Note: When upgrading from debug-signed `v1.26v`, uninstall `v1.26v` once before installing `1.27v` if Android reports a signature conflict; all future updates install in-place automatically.)*
**Major 1.27v Update Notice**: All EcoDot `v1.26v` users automatically receive this over-the-air update prompt with release notes and direct APK download.

**120Hz Zero-Lag Engine & R8 Build**: Eliminated UI jank on high-refresh-rate displays through isolated playback progress state reads, hardware 120Hz display mode selection, and sized bitmap decoding.
**Spotify-Grade Playlist & Track Tools**: Redesigned Playlist view with ambient header gradients + complete scrollable 3-dots Track Options sheet across Home, Search, Library, and Playlists.
New: **Release Keystore Build Pipeline**: Dedicated release `signingConfig` via `keystore.properties` / environment variables with clean fallback for open-source contributors.

**Spotify Playlist Interface**: Centered artwork (with Spotify's iconic purple Heart gradient for Liked Songs & 2x2 mosaics for playlists), ambient Palette gradients, one-tap Download All, Shuffle, green Play/Pause FAB, and clean borderless track rows.

**Redesigned Track Options Sheet**: Grouping Quick Actions (Play Next, Add Queue, Playlist) with full scrollable controls — Save/Remove Liked Songs, Download, Remove from Playlist, Switch to Music Video/Audio, Sleep Timer, Looping Canvas, Now Playing Style, Equalizer, Ringtone Clipper, and Album/Artist navigation.
**Interactive Profile Photo Adjuster**: Pinch/drag pan, zoom slider (`1x–5x`), 90° rotate, and circular crop preview (`AvatarCropMath`) inside the minimal Profile page.

**Upgraded Update & News Dialog**: Structured release spotlight card, version delta badge (`v1.26v -> v1.27v`), package size display, and clickable GitHub attribution (`Made by Debug01-dEoW aka Deep` on Home & Update screens).
Improved: **Cleaner Home Footer**: Removed the 'SimpMusic UI • Liquid Glass • YouTube Music' subtitle line for a cleaner `© 2026 EcoDot` + `Made by Debug01-dEoW aka Deep` footer.
**Crystal-Clear Liquid Glass Optics**: Restored crisp optical refraction and low-haze lens clarity across Home header chips, Search Bar, filter pills, MiniPlayer, and bottom navigation bar.
**Minimal Distraction-Free Profile & Player Themes**: Cleaned up Profile clutter and removed redundant Song/Video toggle pills from Spotify and Vinyl Now Playing layouts.
**Removed Recent Search Black Backdrop**: Eliminated the opaque dark sticky header box behind 'Recent searches | Clear search history'.
Fixed: Replaced shared Android Debug signing with EcoDot's dedicated release keystore for Play Protect trust and clean future updates.
Fixed 3-dots menu in playlists only showing a 6-item dropdown instead of all track actions.
Fixed vertical clipping at the bottom of TrackOptionsBottomSheet by enabling full sheet scrolling and navigation bar insets.
Fixed smoky/dark backdrop artifacts on Home and Search headers and eliminated 120Hz scroll frame drops.
